assignment: Exactly monoblack or monored Oracle colors, including reprints and admitted members
audit_scope: Full Oracle and full card XMage implementation bodies reviewed for all75 cards. Relevant shared Rust types/implementations and selected nontrivial reusable XMage bodies reviewed. Direct reusable-reference pins retained; records explicitly distinguish reference bodies read in this audit. Basic shared-reference source review and concrete test execution remain part of complete-card acceptance, not implied by this ledger.

speed-value.gap: No StatValue for controller/player speed. Add generic live quantity to actual/speculative worlds and Item AmountValue via Stat. Reuse SourceConditionalKeywords, StatExpr, KeywordGrant, StepGuard::Expression for max-speed effects.
tests: Speed persists through source departure; one inherent trigger each own turn only after loss while started, capped at 4; conditional keywords/PT/step effects read current controller and are suppressed with their actual abilities.
Copies of inherent speed triggers use resolving controller; owned branch/restore preserves designation and used-turn marker.

graveyard-max-speed.gap: SourceMaxSpeedActivation enumeration in visit_source_grants currently requires giver.zone == Battlefield; max-speed graveyard activations require zone-aware grant/guard availability, affordability and ownership.
tests: Surveyor exile+draw unavailable at speed 3, available at 4 in owner graveyard, unavailable from battlefield or foreign graveyard; pays exile before stack; stale source rejects transactionally.

exhaust-event.gap: No ExhaustAbilityActivated trigger qualification. Emit only on actual activation commitment (not failed announcement, copying, resolution).
tests: Adrenaline gains one counter for own exhaust activation, none for opponent, nonexhaust, copied ability or failed funding; trigger survives ability countering.
Multiple exhaust abilities have independent exact-incarnation use histories.

caster-off-turn.gap: DuringOpponentsTurn checks active player against observer controller; Adrenaline requires actual spell caster != active player, any-player cast, and fixed caster damage recipient. Add distinct event qualification, never change existing wrapper semantics.
tests: With either observer seat, own off-turn and opposing off-turn casts deal 4 to actual caster; active-player casts and spell copies do not; observer departure retains packet.

capped-name-exile-search.gap: General choose-card-name (all legal names) then optional graveyard/hand/library search capped across all three zones, exiling at most four without replacement draws. Existing CoverUpSearch is based on graveyard choice, unbounded and draws for hand exiles.
tests: Name is chosen at resolution; choose 0..4 across mixed zones, including omitted public graveyard copies; names compare interchangeably; target shuffles even at zero; hidden search details not exposed to opponent; branch/restore owns selection.

untargeted-graveyard-kind-subtype.gap: Need nontargeting mandatory resolution choice of creature OR Vehicle from entire own graveyard after milling (not only newly milled cards); existing RecoverMilled supports Permanent/Land only and selects from milled batch.
tests: Carrion returns a preexisting creature or an unanimated Vehicle, can choose just-milled card, cannot return other artifacts or other graveyard, and returns none when no match; stale ETB source does not matter.

discard-event-amount.gap: Discard batch count is already retained for PutDiscardCounters/DamageDiscardAmount but no general AmountValue::DiscardEventCount for CreateTokensScaled. Add captured quantity or specialized generic token-from-discard instruction.
tests: One simultaneous 2-card discard creates two tapped Zombies from one Cryptcaller trigger; two separate discards create separate triggers; actual discard replacement, cycling and observer death use correct frozen counts.

embalm-grant.gap: No embalm: temporary exact-graveyard activation grant priced from printed mana cost, sorcery timing, exile source cost, copiable white/Zombie/no-mana-cost token exceptions. CopyExceptions currently lacks those general exceptions.
tests: Grant expires at cleanup/source incarnation change but survives Wrappings departure; sorcery-only paid exile creates one white Zombie with original name/abilities/types, no mana cost/MV0; X in cost is zero; no mana cost means unpayable.
Token copy preserves embalm exceptions; granted graveyard activation and pending token entry branch independently; buff sees Zombie as token enters.

destruction-result.gap: Demonic Junker needs simultaneous up-to-one own/one enemy creature destruction and one +2 source counter effect conditional on actual successful destruction of an own creature. Do not infer from selected target or final graveyard result alone.
tests: Choose zero/one each controller; indestructible/regeneration or prohibited destruction fails bonus; successful destruction replaced to exile still qualifies if rules destroy event succeeds; both targets destroyed give exactly two counters once; dead source receives none.

cost-union-kind-subtype.gap: SacrificeFilter combines kind and subtype conjunctively; cannot express creature OR Vehicle, Mount OR Vehicle. Generalize typed cost/filter predicates with OR while preserving affordability and speculative reservation.
tests: Creature-only and unanimated Vehicle-only are accepted, ordinary artifact and source when another required are rejected; multitype candidate counted once; restrictions and speculative mana-source sacrifice order agree.

after-main-combats.gap: Existing AdditionalCombat increments count consumed only at EndCombat; Full Throttle needs two inserted combat phases immediately after the current main phase (including Main2), no inserted main phase, and a source-independent begin-each-combat trigger through cleanup untapping all current creatures that attacked this turn.
tests: Main1 adds two combats before normal combat; Main2 adds two combats before end step; multiple effects insert phases deterministically; no main phase between extra combats.

Delayed trigger uses actual declaration history of all players and exact current incarnations, triggers each combat, survives spell departure/copy, expires at cleanup; non-main resolution adds no phases but still registers delayed effect.

caster-foreign-owned.gap: CastFilter::NotOwnedByYou compares owner to observer controller; Gonti needs owner != actual caster and token created by actual caster. Add separate filter rather than changing inherited semantics.
tests: Both seats casting foreign-owned spells produce Treasure for caster even when Gonti controlled by either seat; casting own spell produces none; copies not cast produce none.

combat-foreign-face-down-play.gap: Reuse PlayerDamaged creature filter + captured controller, but add source-independent permanent foreign face-down exile/play permission for exact top-card incarnation, actor-specific look permission and any-mana spending for spells. Existing face-down play primitives are subtype-gated/source controller/self library.
tests: Gonti exiles top library card of damaged opponent face down for creature controller captured at damage; source changes/departure do not revoke; only permitted player sees face and may play land with normal limit/timing or spell with any mana.

Double strike creates two sequential triggers; empty library does nothing; stolen creature/observer controllers remain independent; permission invalidated by leave/reentry; owned raw/index/restore retains private card information.

capped-rummage.gap: Existing DiscardAnyDraw supports any number/all and DiscardUpToOneDraw caps one; add bounded optional discard 0..N then draw actual completed count (Greasewrench N=2).
tests: 0/1/2 cards selected draw 0/1/2 and exactly one source counter; third cannot be selected; discard replacement count reflects actual discards; private selection and independent branches.

delayed-target-dies.gap: Grim Javelineer creates delayed death trigger controlled by resolving trigger controller, not ability granted to creature. Existing GrantUntilEndTurn queues SelfDies under dying creature controller, so it is not equivalent. Generalize exact target delayed-death registration (ManifestDreadWhenTargetDies has narrow behavior).
tests: Any attacking target gets +1/+0; if creature control changes then dies same turn original resolving controller surveils; source departure/ability removal does not cancel delayed trigger; target blink cannot rebind; cleanup expires.

sacrifice-cost-facts.gap: Hellish Sideswipe needs frozen subtype of actual additional-cost sacrificed permanent and conditional draw after destruction. Existing scalar sacrifice facts capture power/mana value but no generic paid Vehicle predicate.
tests: Sacrifice ordinary artifact/creature pays but no draw; noncreature Vehicle pays and draws; animated Vehicle qualifies once; target becoming illegal fizzles whole spell including draw; copied spell inherits paid-cost facts appropriately.

combat-only-token-requirement.gap: Howlsquad creates token at begin combat and requires that exact actual token to attack this combat if able, including after source departure. Generic keyword MUST_ATTACK lasts too long unless temporary combat-expiring requirement is added.
tests: Generated token inherits haste from live Heavy and must attack this combat; removing Heavy can remove haste and make it unable; tapped/restricted token need not attack; requirement ends this combat, not all later combats.

sacrifice-or-discard-fallback.gap: Momentum Breaker requires opponent sacrifice a creature/Vehicle if able, otherwise mandatory discard; existing optional ChooseObjects skip means decline not inability and must not supply fallback incorrectly. Add explicit can-pay/failure branch using union predicate.
tests: Opponent chooses among own creature and unanimated Vehicle; if none or sacrifice prohibited, discards; cannot opt to discard while able to sacrifice; empty hand handles failure; non-targeting effect works with player hexproof.

speed-player-damage.gap: Outpace Oblivion needs damage 2 to each player whose own speed is <4. Add generic per-player speed predicate/scalar or narrow typed effect; do not evaluate only controller speed.
tests: Both/noncontroller/controller/neither below max gives independently correct recipients; damage replacement/prevention and own-turn speed-trigger behavior remain real events.

filtered-mass-return-delayed-sacrifice.gap: Push the Limit needs simultaneous own graveyard Mount OR Vehicle return with exact successful entrants remembered for next-end-step delayed sacrifice. Existing ReturnOwnedGraveyardNonlandPermanents and ReturnGraveyardCreatures cannot filter arbitrary subtype union or schedule these delayed sacs; Mobilize only token results.
tests: Mount/noncreature Vehicle return together, ordinary creature/artifact excluded; replacements and ETB triggers see batch; animate all currently controlled Vehicles and haste all current creatures.
At next end step sacrifice only remembered exact entrants still controlled as required; blink prevents stale sacrifice; effects survive source/spell departure and owned restore.

post-mill-target-threshold.gap: Quag Feast targets creature/planeswalker/Vehicle before milling; compare current target mana value with current controller graveyard size AFTER actual mill then conditionally destroy. Existing target-time max_mana would be wrong. Add conditional typed instruction using target current facts.
tests: Target too large at cast can become destroyable after mill; mill replaced to exile must not inflate graveyard count; invalid sole target prevents mill; target card copy/X/current face mana values follow live permanent rules.

crew-saddle-participant-event.gap: No event for this creature paying another object crew/saddle cost during own main. Emit participant event on committed activation/tap payment, freeze exact Mount/Vehicle as untargeted event object, preserving buffs even if crew/saddle ability countered.
tests: Velocitaur contribution triggers once for each qualifying payment in Main1/Main2, not combat/opponent turn; recipient gets +2/+0 and trample before animation if stack order chosen; departed/reentered recipient not rebound; pay several participants and each observer fires independently.

graveyard-self-cast-additional-cost.gap: Wickerfolk needs persistent self graveyard cast permission with normal mana plus 2 life and artifact-or-creature sacrifice only when casting through this permission. Existing temporary general permissions and global spell AdditionalCost must not apply costs to hand casts or unrelated permission casts.
tests: Hand cast pays ordinary cost; own graveyard permission cast pays mana+2 life+one artifact/creature; insufficient life/permanent unavailable; can pay exactly life total then lose at SBA; borrowed/suppressed permission and alternate existing permission route preserve correct costs; failed payment rolls back.
